mentions.name: C Course
mentions.description: This project is a C language course that helps beginners learn the language and practice writing simple code without AI assistance. It is a work in progress.
mentions.problem: C is becoming a niche craft as AI agents take over coding, and there are fewer ways for beginners to learn it.
mentions.audience: Beginners who want to learn the C language
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been very slowly making a C language course to let beginners learn a bit about the language and practice writing simple code with no AI: https://c-course.com

evidence.value: I've been very slowly making a C language course to let beginners learn a bit about the language and practice writing simple code with no AI: https://c-course.com
